display_title: See You at the Chili Pepper Field!
description:
Tae-Mi, the spoiled daughter of a chaebol family, not only repeatedly botched new ventures but also caused a major scandal with her clueless social media posts. Ultimately, at her furious father's command, Tae-Mi is demoted to Sunchang-ri, the chili pepper capital. A city girl through and through, Tae-mi screams at the sight of the remote village before her. But meeting Kang-Hun, a young farmer and breathtakingly handsome man living in a watermill at the edge of a chili field, instantly recharges her motivation. Soon, after accidentally witnessing Kang-Hun's well-built lower body and striking beauty, she throws caution to the wind and begins aggressively pursuing him... .!

A spicy-sweet, farm-fresh romance straight from the countryside!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
